subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + evidence upload plan for Nimbus renewal & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <audit@acme-security.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Patel <sophie@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 scope update and evidence window for renewal (Nimbus)

Hi Hannah,

As part of Nimbus Analytics' upcoming renewal and planned capacity increase, our third-party audit team needs an updated evidence bundle and confirmation of your log retention window for the prior 12 months. Specifically, we need:

- Latest SOC 2 report or attestation/bridge letter covering changes since 2027-08-01.
- Audit log retention policy and a sample extract of indexed logs for Jan 2027–Jan 2028.
- Any retention/archival changes tied to the planned capacity uplift (temporary burst windows).

Nimbus is targeting a renewal signature by 2028-02-24 and has requested a temporary 30% burst allowance to upload older archives to our S3 staging location to satisfy the auditor. Can Redwood provide a recommended evidence upload schedule that won't impact production latency?

Appreciate a quick runbook and any pricing implications that Nimbus should expect.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Principal, Acme Security Audits

---
Attachments: none listed
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <audit@acme-security.com>, Sophie Patel <sophie@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 scope update and evidence window for renewal (Nimbus)

Hi Liam / Sophie,

Thanks — we can support this. Quick summary of the plan I propose:

1) Evidence bundle: we will provide a SOC 2 bridge letter (covers 2027-08-01 to present) and the underlying control evidence items requested. Expect the bridge as a PDF; detailed artifacts will be provided as CSV/XLSX listings and log extracts.

2) Log retention & extract: Redwood retains detailed audit logs for 18 months by default for enterprise customers. We'll produce an indexed extract for Jan 2027–Jan 2028 (redacted PII where required).

3) Upload schedule: to avoid inference impact, recommend a staggered ingestion window over 48 hours using low-priority background channels. See proposed slots in the attached spreadsheet.

4) Capacity uplift: we can provision a temporary 30% burst for 72 hours. That will require a short uplift order in the console; Vanessa, can you confirm pricing and billing flow?

I'll attach the evidence manifest (CSV) and the upload schedule. Karthik — can you confirm the stagger parameters and any guardrails for KV cache warmup during the load?

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0186

Attachments: nimbus_evidence_manifest.csv, evidence-upload-schedule.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 scope update and evidence window for renewal (Nimbus)

Thanks Hannah. A few technical clarifications from the runtime side:

- Staggering: recommend 8 rolling shards, each scheduled every 3 hours (total window ~48–56 hours including verification). This keeps P99 latency headroom.
- KV cache warmup: we'll seed prefixes on a single-datacenter path, avoiding global cache thrash. If Nimbus can point the upload to a single region (us-west-2) we'll keep cross-region traffic minimal.
- Audit export format: JSON-lines compressed (gzip) is preferred; CSV manifests are fine for the index but logs should be compressed.

I also suggest we record the upload as an addendum to the renewal (temporary capacity uplift fee + one-time data ingress charge). Vanessa — ballpark margin and whether we can offer a one-time uplift credit tied to a 12-month committed seat increase?

Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Serving Runtime
